keyEvents.text: Goal! Brann 0, AGF 1. Tobias Bech (AGF) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Brann 0, AGF 2. Daníel Grétarsson (AGF) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Kristian Arnstad with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Brann. Kristian Eriksen replaces Joachim Soltvedt.
Goal! Brann 1, AGF 2. Niklas Castro (Brann) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Brann 1, AGF 3. Stefen Tchamche (AGF) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Callum McCowatt.
Goal! Brann 1, AGF 4. Magnus Knudsen (AGF) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, AGF. James Bogere replaces Stefen Tchamche.
Substitution, AGF. Markus Solbakken replaces Callum McCowatt.
Substitution, AGF. Luka Callø replaces Tobias Mølgaard.
Substitution, AGF. Rasmus Carstensen replaces Jacob Andersen.
Substitution, Brann. Sævar Magnússon replaces Niklas Castro.
Substitution, Brann. Julian Laegreid replaces Noah Holm.
Substitution, Brann. Brage Haugen replaces Ulrik Mathisen.
Substitution, AGF. Sebastian Jørgensen replaces Kristian Arnstad.
